integrity: The universal shape matrix and contact classification follow from the written orbitwise moment certificate and determinant inequality; no experimental data are presented as infinite proof. All other cited mathematical results are attributed to their original public sources.
limitations: Only the fixed second partial-permutohedron parameter and the standard Euclidean ambient geometry are classified. Equivalent prior formulas under capped-simplex or optimal-design terminology remain a bibliography risk. The exact finite checks do not replace the all-dimensional proof.
title: A sharp Löwner contact-orbit transition for second partial permutohedra
